title: Revamp quickstart landing: hero variants, annotated diagrams, and progressive step microcopy
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Create a cohesive visual refresh for the Quickstart landing page focused on three deliverables: a set of hero art variants optimized for responsive layouts and A/B testing, annotated architecture-style diagrams explaining the three Redwood deployment modes (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private), and a progressive step microcopy system for the quickstart flow with accessible visual cues. Work should tie to the 2026 Q2 onboarding push and be ready for handoff to engineering and content owners for implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Three hero variants created: Product-first (screenshot-led), Illustration-first (abstract runtime metaphor), and Minimal CTA-first; each exported at 2x and 3x for mobile/tablet/desktop
Architecture diagrams for Hosted/Dedicated/Private that use a consistent visual language, are labeled for copywriters, and include alt-text drafts
Progressive step microcopy for the 5-step quickstart flow (sign-up, API key, first request, evaluate, next steps) with content variants for technical and non-technical audiences
Accessibility checks complete: color contrast, keyboard focus states for hero CTA, and screen-reader friendly diagram descriptions
Design tokens and export-ready assets uploaded to Figma and Drive with a single implementation guide doc linking to PR templates
design_notes: Prioritize clarity for first-time users: emphasize 'try in seconds' messaging and minimize model jargon in hero
Illustration language should hint at runtime concepts (batching, cache, routing) without being literal; use a layered node motif
Keep CTA hierarchy consistent: primary 'Get started' vs secondary 'See examples' across breakpoints
Prepare a compact diagram variant for narrow viewports and an expanded interactive SVG for desktop
Microcopy should include optional inline hints for developers (e.g., sample curl snippet link) and a short validation checklist for success
updates: 2026-03-01: Ticket created by Maya Thompson with initial brief and stakeholder list (PM, Eng, Docs).
2026-03-03: Discovery session with PM (Janelle Ortiz) and Eng leads (Rahul Mehta). Agreed scope: hero variants + diagrams + microcopy. Action: produce 3 hero concepts by 3/9.

2026-03-07: Mid-week sketch review. Internal feedback: prefer illustration-first for developer landing, keep product screenshot variant for marketing funnel. Noted: need alternate alt-text for diagrams (accessibility).
2026-03-09: Figma prototypes uploaded (link in attachments). Submitted first hero concept set and two diagram treatments. Requesting design review with Docs and Eng (tagged reviewers).

2026-03-10: Design review notes from Docs (Ibrahim Khan): add short microcopy for international audiences and ensure snippet language toggle works with screenshot variant. Action: produce developer-focused microcopy + non-technical variant.

2026-03-11: Engineering sync (ENG-2654): confirmed SVG interaction pattern for expanded diagram and constraints for lazy-loading hero art. Eng asked for separate lightweight hero for low-bandwidth users.
2026-03-12: Updated Figma with WCAG contrast tweaks, added compact diagram exports, and wrote initial implementation guide stub. Next: finalize exports and handoff PR to docs repo by 3/20.
